graph_span_days.description: Number of days to retain per-graph time window (e.g., 30 days).

retention_days.description: Number of days to retain graph data before deletion.

subnet_graph_enabled.description: Whether to generate graphs aggregated per subnet (rather than just per host).

httpd_enabled.description: Enable built-in HTTP server for web interface access.

httpd_port.description: Port on which the HTTP server listens (set to 0 to disable HTTP).

httpd_listen.description: IP address the HTTP server binds to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces, '127.0.0.1' for localhost only).

https_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS for the web interface (requires valid certificates).

https_port.description: Port for HTTPS server (ignored unless HTTPS is enabled).

max_peers.description: Maximum number of individual IP hosts to track.

max_subnets.description: Maximum number of subnets to track for aggregated traffic.

name.description: Network interface name (e.g., 'eth0', 'ens160') to monitor for traffic.

interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to monitor.

cidr_aggregation_enabled.description: Enable CIDR-based grouping (e.g., /24 aggregation) for subnets in reports.

quiet_mode.description: Suppress verbose output to stdout (recommended for background service).

output_filename_prefix.description: Filename prefix for generated HTML and image files.

update_interval_seconds.description: Interval (in seconds) between updates of graphs and HTML files.

max_graph_bandwidth_kbps.description: Maximum bandwidth value (in kbps) to display on graph Y-axis.

min_graph_bandwidth_kbps.description: Minimum bandwidth value (in kbps) to graph (values below this are treated as zero).

log_packet_rates.description: Log packet counts in addition to byte counts (requires kernel support).

max_bytes_before_reset.description: Maximum bytes to accumulate before resetting counters (0 = unlimited).

track_other_protocols.description: Track other IP protocols (e.g., IGMP, GRE, OSPF).
